description: Translator migrations 15-17 as shipped through translator-v22, inside upstream's migration numbering. A database that applied them reports user_version 16 to 18 on the upstream version 15 schema.

15:
CREATE TABLE translation_jobs (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    manga_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    chapter_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    priority INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE translation_images (
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES translation_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    image_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    image_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (job_id, image_id)
)

CREATE TABLE translation_results (
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES translation_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    image_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    committed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (job_id, image_id)
)

CREATE TABLE translation_batches (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES translation_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE translation_events (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    time INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX translation_events_job_time ON translation_events(job_id, time)
16:
CREATE TABLE translation_reviews (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES translation_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    image_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX translation_reviews_page ON translation_reviews(job_id, image_id)
17:
CREATE TABLE translation_operations (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_id TEXT,
    batch_id TEXT,
    image_id TEXT,
    stage TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX translation_operations_job ON translation_operations(job_id, updated_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX translation_operations_parent ON translation_operations(parent_id, updated_at)
CREATE INDEX translation_operations_image ON translation_operations(job_id, image_id)

CREATE TABLE translation_usage (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    time INTEGER NOT NULL,
    provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    model TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX translation_usage_time ON translation_usage(time DESC)
CREATE INDEX translation_usage_job ON translation_usage(job_id, time DESC)

CREATE TABLE translation_billing (
    id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    connection_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    period_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
    period_end INTEGER NOT NULL,
    synced_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE INDEX translation_billing_connection ON translation_billing(connection_id, period_start)
ALTER TABLE translation_events ADD COLUMN operation_id TEXT
ALTER TABLE translation_events ADD COLUMN batch_id TEXT
ALTER TABLE translation_events ADD COLUMN image_id TEXT
ALTER TABLE translation_events ADD COLUMN stage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy'
ALTER TABLE translation_events ADD COLUMN level TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INFO'
CREATE INDEX translation_events_operation ON translation_events(operation_id, time DESC)
CREATE INDEX translation_events_batch ON translation_events(job_id, batch_id, time DESC)
CREATE INDEX translation_events_image ON translation_events(job_id, image_id, time DESC)
